# Assets: Delete an Asset

Area overview and notes: [assets.md](../assets.md)

`DELETE /assets/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Deletes an asset. Returns a `409` when any transaction references the asset.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | The unique identifier (UUID) for the Asset. |

**Response 204**: Asset deleted successfully.

**Errors:** 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 No asset is configured for the supplied id. · 409 The asset cannot be deleted because an existing transaction references it. · 429 Too Many Requests
